name: enforce-naming-conventions
description: Validates that generated code follows naming conventions: camelCase for vars, PascalCase for classes, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants

rules.message: Variables must use camelCase (e.g., userName, not user_name or UserName)
Classes must use PascalCase (e.g., UserManager, not user_manager)
Constants must use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., API_TIMEOUT, not apiTimeout)
Files must use kebab-case (e.g., user-profile.ts, not userProfile.ts)

actions.message: Code violates naming conventions. Please review generated code before committing.
